Hi Rishi,

Quick heads-up from the venue side — PacificAirlines just notified us that the 23:50 HKG–SYD redeye for three of your crew (IDs in attached manifest) is being rebooked with an enforced overnight transit in KL for immigration reasons. That adds ~10 hours between flights and we need to confirm overnight hotel + local ground transport and who covers the overnight booth shift in Melbourne on Monday morning (team arrives on morning of the event).

We don't want booth coverage gaps when you land. Options we can help with: secure transit hotel for the layover (EventLogix rates), cover a short local temp hire to sit midnight–0600 at the booth, or rearrange existing crew flights to keep a staggered arrival.

Can you confirm: 1) which crew can be rerouted to an earlier flight from HKG; 2) if Redwood will approve transit hotel + per diem for overnight stay; 3) if Marissa or Vanessa can cover the midnight handoff remotely until an on-site temp is in place?

Attaching the crew manifest and the flight rebooking stub. We need a decision within 3 hours to avoid additional change fees.

Thanks,
Carmen
EventLogix — Onsite Ops
